The '''1958 Danish 1st Division''' season was the 13th edition of [[Danish 1st Division]] annual [[Association football|football]] competition in Denmark. It was contested by 12 teams.

[[Aarhus Gymnastikforening]] unsuccessfully defended its [[1956–57 Danish 1st Division|1957 title]]. [[Vejle Boldklub]] successfully pursued its 1958 title.

Statistics of [[Danish 1st Division]] in the 1958 season.
